title: Proclamation No. 403, s. 2012
text:
MALACAÑAN PALACE MANILA

PROCLAMATION NO. 403

DECLARING THURSDAY, 21 JUNE 2012, AS A SPECIAL (NON-WORKING) DAY IN THE CITY OF TAGAYTAY

WHEREAS, Thursday, 21 June 2012, marks the celebration of the “Araw ng Tagaytay” of the City of Tagaytay;

WHEREAS, it is but fitting and proper that the people of the City of Tagaytay be given full opportunity to celebrate and participate in the occasion with appropriate ceremonies.

NOW, THEREFORE, I, PAQUITO N. OCHOA JR. , Executive Secretary, by authority of His Excellency, BENIGNO S. AQUINO III, do hereby declare Thursday, 21 June 2012, as a special (non-working) day in the City of Tagaytay.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF , I have hereunto set my hand and caused the seal of the Republic of the Philippines to be affixed.

Done in the City of Manila, this 11 th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Twelve.

By authority of the President:

(Sgd.) PAQUITO N. OCHOA JR. Executive Secretary
